name: Salem 1692
summary: Social deduction witch-hunt where townsfolk try to reveal all Witch Tryal cards while hidden Witches try to kill the town.
rules_text: Each player gets face-down Tryal cards; any Witch card makes you a Witch forever, even if later lost. One Town Hall power each. Deal 3 playing cards. Put Conspiracy in deck and Night at bottom; set Black Cat aside. At Dawn, Witches eyes-open secretly give Black Cat to any player. First player is Black Cat holder. On your turn you must either draw 2 cards (Black cards revealed and resolved instantly) or play any number of cards on others, never yourself. Green cards are one-shot, Blue stay, Red are accusations. At 7 accusations the accuser reveals one of that player's Tryal cards; if Witch revealed, that player dies. When Conspiracy is drawn, reveal one Tryal on Black Cat holder, then each player takes one unrevealed Tryal from left, becoming Witch if they gain a Witch card. When Night is drawn, all close eyes, Witches choose a kill, Constable chooses a save; if different player, victim dies. Witches win when all non-Witches dead; Town wins when all Witch Tryal cards are revealed.
rating_reason: Social deduction hidden roles, fits talk and elimination
